items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Like you say, Shafi Hadi was one of the sidemen, you know, same as I was. I was a sideman then.

ctx.x: Was it different to play with Gerry Mulligan? He had no piano. Did that change your playing?

No that may be rare, I wanted to do more. But it was a lot of, at that time it was a lot of no piano playing, that I was doing, but I also did a lot of other groups. Like you say, Shafi Hadi was one of the sidemen, you know, same as I was. I was a sideman then.
I wanted to back up just a little bit. You said your family, was it Baptist? You said Holy Roller I think.
